confirmed_facts.claim: Coinbase and Circle's relationship evolved from the 2018 50/50 Centre Consortium to Circle's sole governance of the Circle stablecoin network after Circle acquired Coinbase's remaining 50% Centre interest for $209.9M in Circle shares in August 2023 and dissolved Centre in December 2023.

Circle's 2023 collaboration agreement gave Coinbase a minority equity stake in Circle and a distribution/payment arrangement. The S-1 post-IPO ownership table shows Coinbase with 7,901,791 shares, approximately 3.7% after the IPO; the current 2026 percentage is not disclosed by the sources reviewed.

The collaboration payment base is derived from income on stablecoin reserves after specified third-party management fees and expenses. Circle retains an issuer portion; both parties receive product economics linked to balances held in their custodial/managed products; after approved ecosystem participants are paid, Coinbase receives 50% of the remaining payment base.
Coinbase's Q3 2026 Form 10-Q says its arrangement with Circle was renewed on the same terms and average USDC held in Coinbase products reached an all-time high.

Coinbase stablecoin revenue was $306.905M in Q3 2026, down approximately 5% year over year, and $904.487M for the first nine months of 2026, versus $907.485M in the comparable 2025 period. Coinbase attributes +$84.6M to higher average USDC balances and -$52.8M to lower average interest rates for the three-month comparison.

Coinbase's Q3 2026 Form 10-Q reports USDC AOP of $8.616B at September 30, 2026. This is a point-in-time Assets on Platform measure and is not directly reconciled in the filing to the separate all-time-high average USDC-held-in-products metric.
Circle Q2 2026 total revenue and reserve income was $701.315M, including $667.733M reserve income; reserve income represented 95.2% of Q2 total revenue and 94.6% for H1 2026.

Circle incurred $324.6M in Q2 2026 and $655.3M in H1 2026 distribution costs under its agreements with Coinbase. H1 payments to Coinbase increased $19.8M year over year, driven by higher reserve income, partly offset by a lower Coinbase share of average USDC on-platform balances.
Circle's Q2 2026 filing reports average daily USDC in circulation growth of 25.2% year over year in Q2 and 31.7% for H1.

Circle's 100bp reserve-yield-down sensitivity estimates $737M lower reserve income and $360M lower distribution/transaction costs over the following twelve months, assuming June 30, 2026 USDC circulation and reserve allocation remain constant. This is a company scenario sensitivity, not a forecast.

Coinbase Q3 2026 net income was $718.7M and Adjusted EBITDA was $332.9M. The filing reports $715.0M gains on crypto assets held for investment, primarily Bitcoin and Ethereum. The separate investments line was a $39.2M loss in Q3 2026 versus a $400.25M gain in Q3 2025, with the change largely attributed to fair-value remeasurement of Coinbase's Circle investment after Circle's IPO.

inferences.claim: Coinbase's equity stake and contractual distribution payments create direct financial alignment with Circle's USDC growth, while Circle retains sole governance of the Circle stablecoin network. The relationship is both strategic and economically interdependent, not merely an exchange listing.

Circle and Coinbase share exposure to reserve yields and USDC balances: Circle's reserve income funds the payment base, and Coinbase's stablecoin revenue is sensitive to both average USDC balances and interest rates. This creates a joint macro sensitivity to rates and stablecoin circulation.

This financial relationship does not establish proportional XRP demand. Circle USDC's XRPL deployment, Coinbase's XRP/cbXRP custody, and Coinbase's Circle distribution economics are separate relationships until transaction-level routes or flows connect them.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's minority Circle equity stake and revenue-sharing arrangement incentivize USDC distribution and platform balances, strengthening the USDC ecosystem.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: Coinbase's share of average USDC on-platform balances declined in Circle's H1 2026 comparison even while total USDC circulation grew; Coinbase's stablecoin revenue fell 5% YoY in Q3 2026.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Falling reserve yields can reduce Circle reserve income and Coinbase stablecoin revenue even when USDC balances grow.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: Higher USDC circulation and average balances can partially offset lower reserve yields; Circle's 100bp sensitivity holds circulation constant and is not a forecast.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Circle's USDC deployment on XRPL and Coinbase's XRP/cbXRP custody could be complementary to XRPL ecosystem growth.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: No evidence in the filings establishes material Coinbase USDC distribution on XRPL, USDC-to-XRP conversion flow, or a causal relationship between Circle's distribution payments and XRP demand.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI Holdings' separate investments/partnerships with Circle and Ripple make SBI an indirect strategic bridge between both ecosystems.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: No evidence establishes coordinated capital allocation, shared governance, or an SBI VC Trade stablecoin route on XRPL; current VCTRADE network support lists USDC/RLUSD on Ethereum and JPYSC transfers unsupported.

unknowns: Coinbase's exact current Circle share count and percentage after subsequent dilution or transactions.
Reconciliation between the $22B average USDC-held-in-Coinbase-products metric and $8.616B USDC AOP at September 30, 2026.
Coinbase's material USDC deposit/withdrawal support on XRPL and actual USDC-on-XRPL balances distributed by Coinbase.
Q3 2026 Circle financial results; company results were scheduled for November 4, 2026.
Any transaction-level USDC/RLUSD-to-XRP conversion volume or causal effect on XRP spot demand.
Current SBI Circle JV ownership split and product-level USDC flows through SBI VC Trade.
disconfirming_evidence: Circle's 2026 Q2 filing says Coinbase's share of average USDC on-platform balances declined in the H1 comparison, even as total USDC circulation grew.
Coinbase's Q3 2026 stablecoin revenue fell approximately 5% year over year despite average USDC balances reaching an all-time high, demonstrating rate and accounting sensitivity.
SBI VC Trade currently lists USDC and RLUSD on Ethereum, not XRPL; JPYSC deposits/withdrawals are unsupported at capture.
Circle USDC on XRPL does not require native XRP for every transaction; no proportional XRP demand can be inferred.

circle_coinbase_contract.issuer_retention: Circle retains a variable issuer portion of reserve payment base
circle_coinbase_contract.product_economics: Both parties receive amounts tied to stablecoins held in their custodial/managed products
circle_coinbase_contract.ecosystem_economics: After approved participants, Coinbase receives 50% of remaining payment base
circle_coinbase_contract.current_status: Coinbase Q3 2026 10-Q says arrangement renewed on same terms

actual_capital_classification.circle_reserve_income: Interest/dividend income on segregated reserve assets; not new XRP capital.
actual_capital_classification.coinbase_distribution_cost: Expense paid by Circle to Coinbase for distribution; not an XRP purchase or external XRP capital inflow.
actual_capital_classification.coinbase_circle_equity: Corporate equity investment; not XRP holdings.
actual_capital_classification.xrp_spot_or_collateral_flow: Not established by these corporate filings.
